message.content:
**Miami’s main train hub – Miami Central Station (formerly the Miami Intermodal Center)**

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Location** | 1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33131 |
| **Train Service** | Amtrak (Silver Service – Silver Meteor & Silver Star) |
| **Pet Policy at the Station** | Pets are **not allowed inside the station building** (no pets in the waiting areas, ticket counters, or platforms). |
| **Pet Policy on the Train** | Amtrak permits small pets (dogs, cats, etc.) in the baggage area or on the train’s designated pet space, provided they are in a carrier and the owner pays a small fee. |
| **Why it’s the closest “pet‑friendly” option** | While the station itself doesn’t allow pets, the train service that departs from there does. If you’re traveling by train from Miami, you can bring your pet on board under Amtrak’s pet rules. |

### Bottom line
There isn’t a train station in Miami that lets pets roam freely inside the building. The best you can do is use Miami Central Station as your departure point and then bring your pet onto the Amtrak train, which does allow small animals in a carrier.
